title: %expr - variables and sqrt
purpose: Variables resolve under an explicit bindings object; sqrt is whitelisted.
notes: The names x and y read @.v.x and @.v.y from the bindings object; the hypotenuse of 3 and 4 is 5.
A formula that uses a variable without a bindings object fails to compile.

avoid.why: the bindings object is required when the formula has variables; pass it as @.v
